EXECUTION METHODOLOGY
01 — SURVEY & CLEARANCE

GPR & Municipal Approvals

Subsurface Ground Penetrating Radar mapping, robotic pipeline endoscopy and municipal utility permits prior to mobilization.

02 — CAST & MOBILIZE

Precast Yards & Shafts

Precision casting of I-girders, U-girders and bridge segments alongside thrust/reception shaft construction.

03 — ERECT & TUNNEL

Balanced CLC & M-TBM

Scaffolding-free balanced cantilever post-tensioning and laser-guided micro-tunnelling with zero surface disruption.

04 — CERTIFY & HANDOVER

QA/QC & Commissioning

Stage-wise quality verification, permanent pavement restoration and statutory completion certification on schedule.

+91 97170 00439

Both entities operate under the leadership of Rashique Zia from our New Delhi and Mumbai offices. Arm & Skill Contractors (est. 2009, 330-strong civil workforce) executes heavy civil, metro, bridge and Balanced Cantilever works, while Arms & Skill Infratech Pvt. Ltd. (ASIPL, inc. 2010, 90+ specialists) specializes in trenchless Micro-Tunnelling (M-TBM), HDD, utility diversion, GPR surveys and PEB fabrication.

We execute Micro-Tunnelling (M-TBM) for 600mm to 1800mm+ diameter sewer and water lines, Pipe Jacking (42-inch minimum worker-entry diameter) and PSC pipe pushing up to 1500mm, plus Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD) for HDPE/MS pipelines and power cables under live highways, metros and railway crossings.

Yes. Our dedicated CLC team completed Balanced Cantilever viaducts for L&T on DMRC CC-28 over the busy Ring Road at Mayapuri and ESI Hospital Punjabi Bagh in New Delhi, and executes river-pier CLC spans over the Bhagirathi River (6 piers in mid-river) for HCC on NH-34 PKG-3, West Bengal.

Yes. We hold official DMRC Phase-IV sub-contractor approvals (DC-02, DC-05, DC-09), Maharashtra PWD Class-IV Contractor Registration, active multi-state GSTINs (Delhi, Mumbai, Assam), EPFO registrations, Udyam MSME certificates, and verified completion certificates from BSES, L&T, Tata Projects, J Kumar and Afcons.

With permanent regional hubs in New Delhi (Jasola) and Mumbai (Goregaon West), we have active mobilization capability across India—backed by executed works in Delhi NCR, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Telangana, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and Assam.
